title: Differentiable Synthesis and Yield Optimization of Cross-Coupled Resonator Filters
summary: Coupling-matrix synthesis of cross-coupled resonator filters is difficult when the desired topology is noncanonical. Automatic differentiation removes the need for problem-specific sensitivity expressions, but does not by itself overcome the nonconvex optimization landscape. This work develops a staged differentiable synthesis framework and identifies the importance of its initial objective through a controlled comparison that varies only the objective of the first optimization phase.
